name: @hazelgrove/hazel-embed
description: React component for embedding Hazel in other applications
author: Hazel Team

scripts.type:patchworkmessages:fix: sed 's/Index/FlatDoc/g' src/types/patchworkmessages.mli > src/types/patchworkmessages.tmp && mv src/types/patchworkmessages.tmp src/types/patchworkmessages.mli
scripts.type:patchworkmessages: tsx node_modules/@ocsigen/ts2ocaml/dist/ts2ocaml.js jsoo --number-as-int --readable-names --preset full --output-dir src/types src/types/patchworkmessages.d.ts && pnpm type:patchworkmessages:fix && cp src/types/patchworkmessages.mli ../src/haz3lcore/patchwork/PatchworkMessages.mli
scripts.type:flatdoc: tsx node_modules/@ocsigen/ts2ocaml/dist/ts2ocaml.js jsoo --number-as-int --readable-names --preset full --output-dir src/types src/types/flatdoc.d.ts && cp src/types/flatdoc.mli ../src/haz3lcore/patchwork/FlatDoc.mli
scripts.type: npm run type:patchworkmessages && npm run type:flatdoc
